part2.audioText: Where should I leave these documents?
part2.explanation: Where 問地點，(A) 回答「放在我桌上」最合理。(B) 誤用 leave 的另一個意思「離開」，(C) 回答寄送方式，答非所問。
When 問時間，(B)「十點半」正確。(A) 回答地點，(C) 回答感想且時態是過去式。

part2.audioText: Who's in charge of the marketing campaign?
part2.explanation: Who 問人，(A)「陳小姐負責」正確。in charge of = 負責。(B) 回答時間，(C) 回答東西。

part2.audioText: Would you like coffee or tea?
part2.explanation: A or B 選擇疑問句要選其中一個，(B)「茶就好」正確。選擇疑問句不能用 Yes/No 回答，所以 (A) 錯誤。
Why 問原因，(C)「因為主管出差」正確。postpone = 延期。(A) 地點、(B) 頻率都答非所問。

part2.audioText: Have you finished the sales report?
optionAudioTexts: Almost. I'll send it to you this afternoon.
part2.explanation: 詢問報告是否完成，(A)「快好了，下午寄給你」正確。(B)(C) 利用 sale/report 的相似音混淆。

part2.audioText: How do I get to the airport from here?
optionAudioTexts: You can take the shuttle bus.
part2.explanation: How 問方法（怎麼去機場），(C)「搭接駁車」正確。(A) 回答時間點，(B) 回答票種。

part2.audioText: This printer isn't working again, is it?
part2.explanation: 附加問句確認印表機又壞了，(A)「對，它壞了，我來叫技師」正確。No 表示同意「它沒在運作」。(B)(C) 用 print 相關詞混淆。

script: M: Hi, Sandra. I just heard that the client from Osaka is visiting our office next Tuesday. Should we book a meeting room?
W: Yes, I already reserved the large conference room on the ninth floor for the whole morning.
M: Great. They want to see a demonstration of our new accounting software, so we'll need a projector and a laptop.
W: The projector in that room was broken last week, but the repair company said it would be fixed by Friday. I'll double-check tomorrow.
M: Thanks. Could you also order some refreshments? Maybe coffee and some pastries.
W: Sure, I'll ask the catering service to deliver them by nine thirty.

options: A client will visit the office.
A new product will be launched.
A training session will be held.
questions.explanation: 男子開頭說 the client from Osaka is visiting our office next Tuesday，大阪的客戶下週二來訪，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What problem does the woman mention?
questions.explanation: 女子說 The projector in that room was broken last week（那間會議室的投影機上週壞了），故選 (B)。她也提到週五前會修好。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman to do?
questions.explanation: 男子說 Could you also order some refreshments?（可以順便訂點心飲料嗎），故選 (C)。refreshments = 茶點。

script: W: Excuse me, I bought this coffee maker here last weekend, but it stopped working after just two days.
M: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have your receipt with you?
W: Yes, here it is. I'd prefer a refund rather than an exchange, if that's possible.
M: Since it's within thirty days, a full refund is no problem. It will take about five business days to appear on your credit card.
W: That's fine. Also, could you tell me if you carry the newer model of this brand?
M: We do, and it's actually on sale this month. It's on aisle seven if you'd like to take a look.

questions.q: Why is the woman visiting the store?
questions.explanation: 女子說咖啡機買兩天就壞了，並要求退款（I'd prefer a refund），可知她是來退還故障商品，故選 (B)。

questions.q: What does the man ask the woman for?
questions.explanation: 男子問 Do you have your receipt with you?（收據有帶嗎），故選 (A)。

questions.q: What does the man say about the newer model?
options: It comes with a free gift.
questions.explanation: 男子說 it's actually on sale this month（這個月特價中），on sale = 特價，故選 (B)。

part4.script: Attention, passengers on Flight 274 to Singapore. Due to heavy rain, your departure has been delayed by approximately fifty minutes. The new boarding time is three fifteen at Gate 12, not Gate 8 as originally announced. We apologize for the inconvenience. Meal vouchers are available at the service counter next to Gate 10 for all passengers on this flight. Please keep your boarding pass ready, as you will need to show it to receive a voucher. Thank you for your patience.

questions.explanation: 廣播說 Due to heavy rain（因為大雨），班機延誤，故選 (B)。
廣播說 at Gate 12, not Gate 8 as originally announced，登機門從 8 號改為 12 號，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What should passengers show to get a meal voucher?
questions.explanation: 最後說 you will need to show it (= your boarding pass) to receive a voucher，須出示登機證，故選 (C)。

part4.script: Hello, this message is for Ms. Patel. This is Kevin from Riverside Dental Clinic. I'm calling to remind you of your appointment with Dr. Wong this Thursday at two o'clock. Please note that our clinic has moved to a new location last month. We are now at 58 Harbor Road, on the third floor of the Pacific Building, right above the bookstore. Parking is available in the basement, and we will validate your parking ticket at the front desk. If you need to reschedule, please call us back at least twenty-four hours in advance. See you Thursday.

options: To remind the listener of an appointment
questions.explanation: 說話者說 I'm calling to remind you of your appointment（提醒您的預約），故選 (B)。

questions.q: What did the clinic recently do?
options: It moved to a new location.
questions.explanation: our clinic has moved to a new location last month，診所上個月搬家，故選 (C)。

questions.q: What is the listener asked to do if she cannot attend?
options: Call at least a day in advance
questions.explanation: please call us back at least twenty-four hours in advance，如需改期請至少提前 24 小時來電，故選 (B)。

part5.q: All employees must submit their expense reports ------- the end of each month.
part5.explanation: by + 時間 = 在…之前（期限），「必須在每月底前提交」。until 表持續到某時，不接一次性動作 submit。

part5.q: The new security system is much more ------- than the previous one.
part5.explanation: more ______ than 比較級中間需要形容詞，reliable（可靠的）正確。rely 動詞、reliably 副詞、reliability 名詞。

part5.q: Ms. Rivera ------- the Tokyo office before she was transferred to Taipei last year.
part5.explanation: before she was transferred（過去式）之前發生的動作，用過去完成式 had managed。句意：調來台北前她管理東京辦公室。

part5.q: Please review the attached contract ------- and let us know if any changes are needed.
part5.explanation: 修飾動詞 review 要用副詞 carefully（仔細地）。「請仔細審閱附上的合約」。

part5.q: ------- the heavy traffic, the delivery truck arrived at the warehouse on time.
part5.explanation: 空格後是名詞片語 the heavy traffic，用介系詞 Despite（儘管）。Although 是連接詞要接子句。句意：儘管塞車，貨車仍準時抵達。

part5.q: Employees who wish to attend the seminar should register ------- Friday afternoon.
part5.explanation: no later than = 不得晚於（期限）。「想參加研討會的員工最晚須於週五下午前報名」。

part5.q: The marketing team proposed several ------- for increasing online sales.
part5.explanation: several + 複數名詞，選 strategies（策略）。「行銷團隊提出數個提升線上銷售的策略」。

part5.q: Neither the manager ------- the assistants were aware of the schedule change.
part5.explanation: 固定搭配 neither A nor B（A 和 B 都不）。「經理和助理都不知道時程變更」。

part5.q: The company will reimburse employees ------- travel expenses incurred during business trips.
part5.explanation: reimburse someone for something = 補償某人某費用。「公司將補助員工出差期間的差旅費」。

part5.q: Applications received after the deadline ------- under any circumstances.
part5.explanation: 主詞 Applications（申請書）是被接受的對象，要用被動語態 will not be accepted。「逾期申請概不受理」。

part5.q: Mr. Osman asked his assistant to make ten ------- of the presentation slides.
part5.explanation: make copies = 影印/複製。「Osman 先生請助理把簡報印十份」。edition 版本、issue 期刊號、volume 冊。

part5.q: ------- joining Horizon Consulting, Ms. Lin worked as a financial analyst for eight years.
part5.explanation: Before + V-ing = 在…之前。「加入 Horizon 顧問公司前，林小姐擔任財務分析師八年」。While 要接子句，During 接名詞。

part6.passage:
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Department
Subject: Elevator Maintenance

Please be advised that the main elevators in Building A will be [33] for maintenance this Saturday from 8:00 A.M. to 5:00 P.M. During this time, employees who need to work on weekends should use the stairs or the freight elevator at the rear of the building. [34], the freight elevator is slower than the main ones, so please allow extra time. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your [35]. If you have questions, please contact the Facilities Department at extension 2280.

questions.explanation: 電梯因維修暫停使用，選 unavailable（無法使用）。下一句提示要改走樓梯或貨梯。
前句說可以用貨梯，後句說貨梯比較慢，語意轉折，選 However（然而）。
公告結尾慣用語 appreciate your cooperation（感謝您的配合），故選 (C)。

part6.passage:
Dear Mr. Baker,

Thank you for your order of office furniture placed on July 25. Unfortunately, the ergonomic chair you requested is temporarily out of stock. We expect a new shipment to arrive [36] two weeks. If you would rather not wait, we can offer you a similar model at the same price. It has received excellent [37] from our customers this year. Please let us know [38] option you prefer by replying to this e-mail. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Sincerely,
Customer Service Team, OfficePlus

questions.explanation: within two weeks = 兩週內。「新到貨預計兩週內抵達」。
receive excellent reviews = 獲得極佳評價，這裡指多位顧客的評價，用複數 reviews。
兩個選項（等貨或換型號）擇一，用 which option（哪一個選項）。範圍明確的選擇用 which。

part7.passage:
【E-mail】
From: Laura Kim <lkim@brightevents.com>
To: David Chou <dchou@nexatech.com>
Subject: Year-End Banquet Venue
Date: November 3

Dear Mr. Chou,

Thank you for choosing Bright Events to organize NexaTech's year-end banquet on December 19. Based on your estimate of 120 guests, I recommend the Garden Hall at the Riverside Hotel. It can seat up to 150 people and has a built-in stage and sound system, which will be convenient for your award ceremony. The rental fee is $2,400, which includes tables, chairs, and basic lighting. Catering is not included; however, the hotel offers banquet menus starting at $35 per person. If you would like to visit the venue, I can arrange a tour next week on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon. Please let me know which day works better for you.

Best regards,
Laura Kim

questions.q: Why did Ms. Kim write the e-mail?
options: To recommend a venue for an event
To request payment for a banquet
To apply for a position at NexaTech
questions.explanation: 信中主旨是推薦 Riverside Hotel 的 Garden Hall 作為尾牙場地（I recommend the Garden Hall），故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is indicated about the Garden Hall?
options: It can hold up to 150 guests.
questions.explanation: It can seat up to 150 people，最多可容納 150 人，故選 (B)。餐飲不含在租金內，$35 是每人餐費起價。

questions.q: What does Ms. Kim offer to do?
questions.explanation: I can arrange a tour next week，她主動提議安排參觀場地，故選 (C)。

part7.passage:
【Notice】
Greenway Fitness Center — Membership Renewal Special

Renew your annual membership before August 31 and enjoy the following benefits:
• 15% off the regular annual fee of $600
• Two free personal training sessions (a $90 value)
• A complimentary Greenway sports towel

Members who renew after August 31 will pay the regular rate and will not receive the free training sessions. Please note that the fitness center will be closed on August 15 for staff training. To renew, visit the front desk with your membership card, or renew online at www.greenwayfit.com. Online renewals will receive an additional 5% discount. For questions, call 555-0134 during business hours (6 A.M.–10 P.M. daily).

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the notice?
options: To announce a new branch opening
To encourage members to renew early
questions.explanation: 公告主要宣傳 8/31 前續約的優惠（Renew before August 31 and enjoy...），目的是鼓勵會員提早續約，故選 (B)。

questions.q: How much is the discount for renewing at the front desk before August 31?
questions.explanation: 8/31 前續約享 15% off；線上續約才「再加」5%。臨櫃續約是 15%，故選 (C)。

options: A fitness contest will be held.
questions.explanation: the fitness center will be closed on August 15 for staff training，8/15 因員工訓練休館，故選 (A)。

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a renewal benefit?
options: A discount on the annual fee
questions.explanation: 優惠包含年費折扣、兩堂免費教練課、贈毛巾；沒有提到免費停車證，故選 (D)。
